sourceSentences.text: No. There is only the one, and he is not even close to us.
Use your nose, if not your brain, Nighteyes scathingly reassured me.
Shall I kill him for you? he offered casually.
Please.
But be careful of yourself.
Nighteyes snorted softly in disdain.
He is fatter far than that wild pig I killed.
He puffs and sweats just to walk down the trail.
Lie still, little brother, while I get rid of him.
Silent as death, the wolf moved off through the forest.
I crouched an eternity, waiting to hear something, a snarl, a scream, the noises of someone running through the brush.
There was nothing.
I flared my nostrils but could catch no trace of the elusive scent.
Suddenly I could no longer stand to crouch and wait.
I surged to my feet and followed the wolf, as silently lethal as he.
Before, when we had been hunting, I had not paid much attention to where we had gone.
Now I perceived that we had approached closer to the Skill road than I had suspected; that our campsite was not that far from it at all.
Like a strain of distant music, I was suddenly aware of their Skilling.
I halted where I stood.
I willed my mind to stillness, and let their Skill brush my senses while I made no response.
I’m close.
Burl, breathless with both excitement and fear.
I sensed him poised and waiting.
I feel him, he draws near.
A pause.
Oh, I like not this place.
I like it not at all.
Be calm.
A touch is all it will take.
Touch him as I showed you, and his walls will come down.
Will spoke, master to apprentice.
And if he has a knife?
He won’t have time to use it.
Believe me.
No man’s walls can stand before that touch, I promise you.
All you need do is touch him.
I will come through you and do the rest.
Why me?
Why not you or Carrod?
Would you really rather have Carrod’s task?
Besides.
You are the one who had the Bastard in your power and was stupid enough to try to hold him in a cage.
Go and complete the task you should have finished long ago.
Or would you care to feel our king’s wrath again?
I felt Burl shiver.
And I trembled, too, for I felt him.
Regal.
The thoughts were Will’s, but somehow, somewhere, Regal heard them, too.
I wondered if Burl knew as plainly as I did that no matter whether he killed the Bastard or not, Regal would enjoy giving him pain again.
That the memory of torturing him was so pleasurable a one that Regal could no longer think of him at all without being reminded of how completely it had satiated him.
Briefly.
I was glad I was not Burl.
There!
That was the Bastard!
Find him!
I should have died then, by all rights.
Will had found me, had found my careless thought floating in the air.
My brief sympathy for Burl was all it had taken.
He bayed on my trail like a hound.
I have him!
There was a moment of poised tension.
My heart hammered against my ribs as I sent the Wit questing out all around me.
Nothing bigger than a mouse was close by.
I found Nighteyes down the hill from me, moving with swift stealth.
Yet Burl had said he drew near to me.
Had he found a way to shield himself from my Wit-sense?
The thought made my knees weak.
Somewhere far down the hill, I heard the crash of a body through brush and a man’s shout.
The wolf was on him, I thought.
No, brother, not I.
I could scarcely understand the wolf’s thought.
I reeled with a Skill-impact, yet could feel no source for it.
My senses contradicted each other, as if I plunged into water and felt it as sand.
With no clear idea of what I did, I began a shambling run down the hill.

Именно ты держал Бастарда в своей власти и оказался настолько глуп, что попытался удержать его в клетке.
Ступай и заверши дело, которое должен был закончить уже давно.

Я почувствовал, как Бёрл содрогнулся.

Ненадолго.
Я был рад, что я не Бёрл.
Там!
Это был Бастард!
Найдите его!

Уилл нашёл меня, нашёл мою неосторожную мысль, плывущую в воздухе.
Достаточно было моей краткой жалости к Бёрлу.
Он взял мой след, словно гончая.
Я нашёл его!
Наступило мгновение напряжённого ожидания.
Сердце колотилось о рёбра, пока я посылал Уит на поиски вокруг себя.
Поблизости не было никого крупнее мыши.
Я нашёл Ночного Волка ниже по склону: он двигался быстро и крадучись.
И всё же Бёрл сказал, что приближается ко мне.
Неужели он нашёл способ заслониться от моего чувства Уита?
От этой мысли у меня ослабели колени.
Где-то далеко внизу по склону я услышал, как тело ломится сквозь кусты, и крик мужчины.
Я подумал, что волк настиг его.

Меня пошатнуло от удара Скилла, но я не чувствовал его источника.

paragraphPairs.sourceText: I crouched an eternity, waiting to hear something, a snarl, a scream, the noises of someone running through the brush. There was nothing. I flared my nostrils but could catch no trace of the elusive scent. Suddenly I could no longer stand to crouch and wait. I surged to my feet and followed the wolf, as silently lethal as he. Before, when we had been hunting, I had not paid much attention to where we had gone. Now I perceived that we had approached closer to the Skill road than I had suspected; that our campsite was not that far from it at all.
paragraphPairs.translatedText: Целую вечность я сидел на корточках, ожидая услышать хоть что-нибудь: рычание, крик, шум человека, продирающегося через кусты. Ничего не было. Я раздувал ноздри, но не мог уловить и следа неуловимого запаха. Внезапно я больше не мог сидеть и ждать. Я вскочил на ноги и последовал за волком, столь же бесшумно смертоносный, как он. Прежде, когда мы охотились, я не особенно следил за тем, куда мы шли. Теперь я понял, что мы подошли к дороге Скилла ближе, чем я думал; что наш лагерь был вовсе не так далеко от неё.

paragraphPairs.sourceText: There was a moment of poised tension. My heart hammered against my ribs as I sent the Wit questing out all around me. Nothing bigger than a mouse was close by. I found Nighteyes down the hill from me, moving with swift stealth. Yet Burl had said he drew near to me. Had he found a way to shield himself from my Wit-sense? The thought made my knees weak.
paragraphPairs.translatedText: Наступило мгновение напряжённого ожидания. Сердце колотилось о рёбра, пока я посылал Уит на поиски вокруг себя. Поблизости не было никого крупнее мыши. Я нашёл Ночного Волка ниже по склону: он двигался быстро и крадучись. И всё же Бёрл сказал, что приближается ко мне. Неужели он нашёл способ заслониться от моего чувства Уита? От этой мысли у меня ослабели колени.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: I should have died then, by all rights.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: My brief sympathy for Burl was all it had taken.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: My brief sympathy for Burl was all it had taken.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: He bayed on my trail like a hound.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: He bayed on my trail like a hound.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.targetText: Он взял мой след, словно гончая.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: I have him!

sourceRanges.text: I have him!

mappedSourceRanges.text: I have him!

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: There was a moment of poised tension.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: There was a moment of poised tension.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.targetText: Наступило мгновение напряжённого ожидания.

sourceRanges.text: There was a moment of poised tension.

mappedSourceRanges.text: There was a moment of poised tension.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: My heart hammered against my ribs as I sent the Wit questing out all around me.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: My heart hammered against my ribs as I sent the Wit questing out all around me.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.targetText: Сердце колотилось о рёбра, пока я посылал Уит на поиски вокруг себя.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: Nothing bigger than a mouse was close by.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: Nothing bigger than a mouse was close by.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.targetText: Поблизости не было никого крупнее мыши.

sourceRanges.text: Nothing bigger than a mouse was close by.

mappedSourceRanges.text: Nothing bigger than a mouse was close by.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: I found Nighteyes down the hill from me, moving with swift stealth.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: I found Nighteyes down the hill from me, moving with swift stealth.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.targetText: Я нашёл Ночного Волка ниже по склону: он двигался быстро и крадучись.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: Yet Burl had said he drew near to me.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: Yet Burl had said he drew near to me.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.targetText: И всё же Бёрл сказал, что приближается ко мне.

sourceRanges.text: Yet Burl had said he drew near to me.

mappedSourceRanges.text: Yet Burl had said he drew near to me.

targetRanges.text: И всё же Бёрл сказал, что приближается ко мне.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: Had he found a way to shield himself from my Wit-sense?
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: Had he found a way to shield himself from my Wit-sense?
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.targetText: Неужели он нашёл способ заслониться от моего чувства Уита?

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: The thought made my knees weak.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: The thought made my knees weak.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.targetText: От этой мысли у меня ослабели колени.

sourceRanges.text: The thought made my knees weak.

mappedSourceRanges.text: The thought made my knees weak.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: Somewhere far down the hill, I heard the crash of a body through brush and a man’s shout.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: Somewhere far down the hill, I heard the crash of a body through brush and a man’s shout.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.targetText: Где-то далеко внизу по склону я услышал, как тело ломится сквозь кусты, и крик мужчины.

mappedSourceRanges.text: Somewhere far down the hill, I heard the crash of a body through brush and a man’s shout.

targetRanges.text: Где-то далеко внизу по склону я услышал, как тело ломится сквозь кусты, и крик мужчины.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: The wolf was on him, I thought.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: The wolf was on him, I thought.

sourceRanges.text: The wolf was on him, I thought.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: No, brother, not I.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: No, brother, not I.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.targetText: Нет, брат, не я.

sourceRanges.text: No, brother, not I.

mappedSourceRanges.text: No, brother, not I.

targetRanges.text: Нет, брат, не я.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: I could scarcely understand the wolf’s thought.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: I could scarcely understand the wolf’s thought.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.targetText: Я едва мог понять мысль волка.

sourceRanges.text: I could scarcely understand the wolf’s thought.

mappedSourceRanges.text: I could scarcely understand the wolf’s thought.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: I reeled with a Skill-impact, yet could feel no source for it.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: I reeled with a Skill-impact, yet could feel no source for it.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.targetText: Меня пошатнуло от удара Скилла, но я не чувствовал его источника.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: My senses contradicted each other, as if I plunged into water and felt it as sand.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: My senses contradicted each other, as if I plunged into water and felt it as sand.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.targetText: Мои чувства противоречили друг другу, словно я нырнул в воду, а ощутил её как песок.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: With no clear idea of what I did, I began a shambling run down the hill.
